long_biography.plain_text:
Scientific training at ETH Zurich and the University of Geneva led Hans-Peter Strebel into pharmacy and drug development. After taking over his father's pharmacy, he founded Fumapharm with three other scientists in 1983. Their work on dimethyl fumarate first produced a psoriasis treatment and later supported an oral therapy for relapsing multiple sclerosis. Biogen acquired Fumapharm in 2006 and continued the programme that became Tecfidera.

Elite sport became his principal public business focus. He joined the EV Zug board, became club president and now chairs the EVZ group while holding a majority shareholding. He also created OYM, a high-performance centre integrating coaching, medicine, nutrition and performance research, and established the OYM sports foundation. The EVZ role is documented ownership and governance; the foundation is a separate philanthropic institution.
